Hi Jeff — thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As promised, attaching a short, customer-facing “microcard” we plan to show in the Console next to the Hosted API toggle. The goal is a two-line explanation plus a 1–2 sentence expandable detail that explains: (1) where data moves when customers use Hosted API, and (2) a brief mention of subprocessors and transfers in plain English.

Attached: console_microcard_draft_v1.docx and our subprocessors list for reference.

Quick ask for Acme: could you confirm whether legal prefers the word “transfer” or “move” in external communications? We want to avoid legalese but stay accurate.

Internal note for Laura/Jonas/Vanessa — I drafted two variants in the attachment (concise + conversational). Can you review and flag anything that would raise procurement or DPA concerns? I’d especially like legal/advisory wording from Laura, and a data-movement clarification from Jonas.

Regards,

Thanks Mina — looked through both variants. High level: I prefer the conversational option but we need a single sentence that licences our data handling without implying we retain customer prompts beyond what customers opt into. Suggested changes in the attached doc:

- Replace "we may store" with "we retain only the data needed to serve your requests unless you opt into logging"
- Add a link to the DPA sentence: "See DPA for details on retention and subprocessors." (we can use a short link)
- For subprocessors, avoid vendor names on the microcard — keep it generic and point to the subprocessor page in Console.

I'll mark the exact lines in the attached doc. Overall this is good for sales and procurement as long as we don't commit to less/more than the DPA.

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Privacy
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — incorporated Laura/Jonas suggestions and Jeff's wording preference. Below is the microcard copy I propose for the Console (finalized for Acme review):

Microcard (one line):
"Requests are processed in the region you select; supporting services may transfer data outside that region."

Expandable detail (1–2 sentences):
"We process requests in the region you choose. We retain only the data you opt into keeping (for example, logging for debugging or performance analytics). Some infrastructure or logging providers we use may be located in other regions — see the Console Subprocessors page or our DPA for the full list and data-transfer safeguards. To request log export or discuss subprocessors, contact procurement@acmeanalytics.com."

Notes: added link placeholders and avoided naming vendors. If Laura signs off on the DPA sentence wording I’ll replace the placeholders with the Console link and push to staging.

Vanessa
Product Marketing Manager, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference
